audience.knowledge: high on the business, mixed on the data estate
priorities: the whole estate, not one store
cost reduction with its certainty stated
data condition and personal-data exposure as preparation work
monetisable products and what each needs first

owner_declarations: The estate owner owns all data in the estate and has declared every right to use it established (owner statement, 2 October 2026). Rights are therefore settled facts, not open questions, and no recommendation is conditional on them.
Personal-data markers remain a measured condition of the rows: de-identification or aggregation is a preparation step for a product, not a rights question.

outputs.role: model workbook: inputs, options, series and cross-checks

purpose.statement: Give the estate owner one estate-wide account from census eij-1b359b3cbd2e — databases, object store and file shares — of what is held, what it costs to keep, what condition it is in and which data products to stand up first, so the owner can decide what to do first.
